state.loader: request_firmware_direct(&fw, image->name, dev); return its error with ENOENT mapped to EPROBE_DEFER. Reject !fw->size or fw->size > image->max_size and release that object. On success store *result = fw. The pair calls this helper for rv32; on error return. Then call for data; on error goto release_rv32. Only after both calls succeed: memcpy_toio(addr, rv32->data, rv32->size); memcpy_toio(base + REG_NPU_LOCAL_SRAM, data->data, data->size); release_firmware(data); release_rv32: release_firmware(rv32); return ret.
state.callers: Both airoha_npu_load_firmware_from_dts and the standard SoC branch of airoha_npu_run_firmware call this same pair loader.
state.tests: 273 host cases with actual extracted loader C and modeled request/resource/map/I/O dependencies pass. All acquired objects must release once. Failure must leave complete code/data destinations unchanged. Four original-source failure controls and six compiled mutation controls fail the named oracles. Complete before/after provider AArch64 objects compile for Linux 6.18.52 without diagnostics. Existing merged-source tests pass 109 memory, 6174 retry, and 44 executor cases.
state.integration: The integrated kernel patch in firmware/overlay is updated, its SHA256 in firmware/source-lock.json matches, and reapplying it to the pinned upstream provider produces the exact tested prepared provider. No new firmware image was built or flashed in this session.
state.reset_evidence: Read-only Ghidra export covers 40 selected stock-kernel functions and direct callers. ecnt_gdma_drv_probe maps the device; ecnt_gdma_drv_remove returns zero without MMIO. boot_npu_all_cores writes boot bases/config/trigger with delays. The clock/reset map has NPU at 0x830 bit 9 and GDMA at 0x834 bit 14. No physical reset/drain or all-master containment has been executed.

request_failure_preflight.instructions: Does state.loader and state.tests support this specific claim: a request failure or empty/oversized image is rejected before either firmware memory copy?

criteria.supported: The pair validates both requests before its first copy, and the scoped tests check failure leaves both destinations unchanged.
criteria.contradicted: A copy occurs before a possible request or size rejection.
criteria.not_established: The supplied evidence is insufficient for the scoped software claim.

resource_release.instructions: Does state.loader and state.tests establish that every successfully acquired firmware object is released once on the covered success/error paths?

criteria.supported: The explicit paths and modeled object ownership checks cover this software claim.
criteria.contradicted: An object is leaked or released twice on a described path.
criteria.not_established: The paths or tests do not establish the scoped claim.

integration.instructions: Which status is established by state.integration and state.tests?

criteria.main_build_input_and_object_tested: The change is in the locked main build input and its provider objects compile; no new flashed image is established.
criteria.flashed_runtime_tested: A new image containing this change was flashed and tested on hardware.
criteria.isolated_only: The implementation exists only in a test and is absent from the locked build input.
criteria.unknown: The state does not establish an integration status.

cold_containment.instructions: Does state.reset_evidence together with the paired-loader change establish contained physical cold reset and complete DMA drain?

criteria.supported: Hardware reset and all-master drain are established.
criteria.not_established: Static register maps, scoped decompilation and request/copy preflight leave physical reset and DMA drain unproved.
criteria.contradicted: The evidence establishes that no such reset could ever contain DMA.
